title: Insulin Pump Program Customer Notice Terms: Liability Notices for Cartridges and Reservoirs
content:
A liability notice for the cartridges a coming refill on an Insulin Pump Program ships above the payer's allowance is signed in the tier's notice type against the newest authorization grant for the cartridge item — the grant that refill draws on — for the notice units of the cartridge or reservoir item the pump uses.

## Terms of signing

1. For a cartridge liability notice, and only for such a notice, the customer signs it personally on the call, through the signing step the representative hands over to them; every other liability notice keeps the general signing rule.
2. The signed notice is recorded on the program's order records for the item, against the authorization grant it is signed for, with the notice form and the billing units it covers, dated the day it is signed; the customer becomes able to receive those units billable to them.

## Notice forms by tier

| Tier | Notice form |
|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program, Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | plan member waiver |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage, form CMS-R-131 |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | Medicaid non-covered service agreement |

## Signing step — `sign_cartridge_liability_notice_61b55bc8`

**Capability.** The customer personally signs the tier's advance notice of financial liability for cartridges or reservoirs on their insulin pump program. The call records one signed notice on the program's order records for the item, against the authorization grant it is signed for, with the notice form and the billing units it covers, dated today. The customer sees the signed notice listed on the program.

**Invocation.** The representative unlocks `sign_cartridge_liability_notice_61b55bc8` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

- `pump_program_id` — the reference number of the customer's insulin pump program, as the representative reads it from the pump program lookup and passes it on.
- `related_pump_order_id` — the reference number of the authorization grant record for the item that the noticed units will draw on and that the notice is signed against, read from the pump order lookup.
- `item_code` — the item the notice covers: `A4225` is the syringe-type cartridge used by Tandem t:slim X2, Tandem Mobi and Beta Bionics iLet pumps; `A4232` is the reservoir used by the MiniMed 780G pump; `E0784` is the pump itself, `A4224` is the infusion-set supply and `A4239` is the pump-integrated sensor allowance, none of which is a cartridge or reservoir line.
- `notice_type` — the notice form signed: `plan_member_waiver` (the member waiver of a commercial HMO or PPO plan), `abn_cms_r_131` (the Original Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage, form CMS-R-131) or `medicaid_non_covered_agreement` (the state Medicaid non-covered service agreement).
- `notice_units` — the cartridges or reservoirs the notice covers, an integer number of billing units, one or more.

**Return.** A receipt with `pump_order_id` (the reference number of the signed notice record), `related_pump_order_id` (the grant it is signed against), `item_code`, `notice_type`, `notice_units`, `notice_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (the value signed when the notice is recorded).
